controls.label: SELECT FILTER

controls.notes: Selection is shared by both channels; each amount/ON control still affects its own deck. FX4 amount is a filter fallback.

controls.label: CHANNEL FX ON
controls.normal: FILTER: filter kill/active toggle. FX1–3: toggle selected slot. FX4: instant FX4.
controls.shift: Same as normal; mixer controls ignore deck SHIFT
controls.notes: Round button above the headphone button. For momentary FX4 turn HOLD off inside djay: hold applies; release stops. The amount knob stays a filter in FX4 mode.
